axes.model_access: Multi-model routing (several frontier models selectable in the UI, official product surface) + a self-built code-docs retrieval index (the product's differentiator: fetching official docs in real time); the concrete model list not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: Web (devv.ai) + browser extension (seen on the official site); retrieval and generation on the vendor's cloud.
axes.local_files: Conversation history stored on the account-side cloud; no officially stated local data surface or offline mode seen (not verified item by item).
axes.background: Q&A returns instantly; no official task queue or "keep-running-after-shutdown" style background task surface seen (not verified item by item).
axes.tools: **Developer-oriented AI search is the main axis**: code questions → real-time retrieval of official docs/code examples → answers with links; codebase-understanding Q&A (official-site narrative); the difference from coding agents: it answers code questions, it does not modify your codebase (boundary ruling: "search-style conversation belongs to research").
axes.context: Retrieval history organized as conversation threads; cross-session memory not verified to an official statement (not verified item by item).
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (D9: pricing not collected); the training-use switch not verified item by item — **code snippets pasted by developers may contain sensitive information; think it through before uploading**.
axes.fit: Fits: looking up API usage/errors/library docs (answers carry official-doc links), Chinese developers wanting a directly reachable search Q&A. Does not fit: modifying codebases (that is the coding category), pasting sensitive code without a second thought.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Index freshness for brand-new framework docs (released <1 month ago)**
- **Hit rate of pasted error-stack → answer** (vs searching Stack Overflow directly)
- **Model-switching differences between the free tier and the paid tier**
